For years, Tess has been deeply immersed in the world of video design, developing her craft with tools like After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Adobe Illustrator. She thrives in the realm of motion graphics, seamlessly blending illustrations into motion to bring stories to life.

Dreams (2020)

Dreams (2020) explores the euphoric and transformative nature of dreams through portrait photography. Using laser cutting techniques, a surreal experience was created—where circular shapes symbolized fluidity and freedom. The final work featured a series of laser-cut portraits suspended within wooden boxes, forming an immersive 3D experience.
